Heroes Reborn: Event Series – The Offici.d: The October/November 2015 issue. Inside: interview with series creator Tim Kring; interview with Zachary Levi (Luke Collins); interview with Jack Coleman (Noah Bennet); and interview with production designer Matthew Davies.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #01.d: The December 2007/January 2008 issue, released November 15, 2007 (UK) and November 20, 2007 (US). Inside: Group interview with Tim Kring, Sendhil Ramamurthy, Greg Grunberg, Adrian Pasdar, Dania Ramirez, Jack Coleman, Zachary Quinto, Masi Oka, Hayden Panettiere, Milo Ventimiglia, and James Kyson Lee; interview with Tim Kring; Heroes personality test; article about the Heroes graphic novels featuring interviews with Micah Gunnell, Michael Turner, and Chuck Kim, as well as a guide to the first 50 issues; and article about the Heroes World Tour. There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #02.d: The February/March 2008 issue, released January 10, 2008 (UK) and January 15, 2008 (US). Inside: an interview with Masi Oka (Hiro Nakamura); a countdown of Claire's 10 grossest injuries; an interview with Jimmy Jean-Louis (The Haitian); a look at the abilities in Heroes; and an interview with Zachary Quinto (Sylar). There was more in it than that. Titan ran two covers an issue, one for the newsagents and one for subscribers; only the subscriber cover survives for this one.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #03.d: The April/May 2008 issue, released March 13, 2008 (UK) and March 18, 2008 (US). Inside: an interview with Hayden Panettiere (Claire Bennet); a look at Peter Petrelli's abilities; an interview with Cristine Rose (Angela Petrelli); a look at the Heroes novel Saving Charlie and an interview with author Aury Wallington; and an interview with artist Tim Sale. There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #04.d: The June/July 2008 issue, released May 15, 2008 (UK) and May 20, 2008 (US). Inside: an interview with Milo Ventimiglia (Peter Petrelli); a look back at season two with commentary by co-executive producer and writer Jesse Alexander; an interview with the show's composers, Wendy Melvoin and Lisa Coleman; the top ten most memorable deaths from Heroes; and an interview with Santiago Cabrera (Isaac Mendez). There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #05.d: The August/September 2008 issue, released July 15, 2008 (US) and August 7, 2008 (UK). Inside: an interview with Greg Grunberg (Matt Parkman); a look at Claire Bennet's abilities; an interview with Kristen Bell (Elle Bishop); Ali Larter discusses hero personal heroes; and Examination of the Helix. There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #06.d: The October/November 2008 issue, released September 16, 2008 (US) and October 9, 2008 (UK). Inside: a catch-up of Season 1 and 2; an interview with Jack Coleman (Noah Bennet); an interview with Tim Kring; an interview with James Kyson Lee (Ando Masahashi); and a look at Candice Wilmer's abilities. There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #07.d: The December 2008/January 2009 issue, released November 18, 2008 (US) and December 11, 2008 (UK). Inside: an interview with Tim Kring; an interview with Zachary Quinto (Sylar); a look at the darker side of some characters; an interview with Brea Grant (Daphne Millbrook); and facts about Hayden Panettiere. There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #08.d: The February/March 2009 issue, released January 20, 2009 (US) and February 5, 2009 (UK). Inside: an interview with Tim Kring; an interview with Ali Larter (Niki and Jessica Sanders / Tracy Strauss); a look at Heroes's relationships; an interview with Kristen Bell (Elle Bishop); and facts about Zachary Quinto. There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #09.d: The April/May 2009 issue, released March 17, 2009 (US) and April 2, 2009 (UK). Inside: an interview with Co-executive producer Adam Armus; an interview with Milo Ventimiglia (Peter Petrelli); Tips for becoming a good superhero based on Hiro Nakamura; an interview with Casting director Natalie Hart; and a look at the destruction of Tokyo. There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #10.d: The June/July 2009 issue. Inside: an interview with Co-executive producer Adam Armus; a look at the "Plane Crash Sequence"; an interview with Masi Oka (Hiro Nakamura); an interview with Ruth Ammon on different places Heroes characters have been; and an interview with Željko Ivanek (Emile Danko). There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #11.d: The September/October 2009 issue. Inside: an interview with Tim Kring; a timeline of Heroes from Season 1 to Season 3; an interview with Ruth Ammon, the Heroes production designer; an interview with James Kyson Lee (Ando Masahashi); and an interview with John Glover (Samson Gray). There was more in it than that.

Heroes: The Official Magazine #12.d: The November/December 2009 issue. Inside: a look at the top 10 villains as voted for by the public; a look at Sylar's story so far; an interview with Adrian Pasdar (Nathan Petrelli); Examining Mind Control and interview with; and an interview with Ray Park (Edgar). There was more in it than that.
